family: Right Wing — Use the Take-Off Space After RB Pulls the Wing Defender Inside
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender still inside on RB — take off toward middle now; finish from GK position (nearer near post), not from handedness alone

family: Right Wing — Read the Wing Defender’s Hips Before Asking for the Ball
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender hips still face RB — stay wide and demand the ball now while the pass lane is open

family: Right Wing — When NOT to Leave the Corner for an Entry
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender already helping inside — stay wide; early entry crowds RB’s driving space and removes the wide pass

family: Right Wing — Pivot Block Opens Take-Off Toward the Middle
primaryTacticalCue: Pivot blocks wing defender’s inside recovery — use take-off toward middle now; finish from GK read

family: Right Wing — Goalkeeper Commits Early Toward the Near Post
primaryTacticalCue: Before take-off GK near foot and near arm move to near post — far side of the goal becomes the available target

family: Right Wing — First Wave: Hold Width in a 3v2
primaryTacticalCue: 3v2 with recovering defender covering middle — RW stays wide to six metres as pass option

family: Right Wing — Second Wave: Stop Forcing When the Transition Advantage Is Gone
primaryTacticalCue: First-wave 2v2 gone as recovering defenders arrive — stay wide into positional attack

family: Right Wing — 6v5: Finish When You Are Free and Help Is Late
primaryTacticalCue: RW alone near sideline; nearest recovering defender >2m from take-off — finish now (6v5 supports, does not alone decide)

family: Right Wing — Empty Own Goal: Safe Finish or Safe Return
primaryTacticalCue: Own goal empty; ball arrives behind body; extra step needed before take-off; opponent wing high for empty-goal shot — safe return

family: Right Wing — Defence: Protect the Pass to the Wing Until Handover
primaryTacticalCue: Team 6:0 rule: protect wing pass with controlled help until handover; do not fully leave early because half is late

family: Right Wing — Defender Stays Home on the Corner
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender stays between you and the six-metre line instead of helping on the RB — do not force the wing pass.

family: Right Wing — Catch Before the Late Recovery
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender is still one stride inside after helping on the RB — receive and take off before his recovery reaches the corner.

family: Right Wing — Inside Take-Off Lane Is Closed
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender has recovered inside your take-off lane with chest facing you — use the free return rather than forcing the middle.

family: Right Wing — Keep the Release Wide
primaryTacticalCue: RB is driving into a crowded gap and you are the only wide release — stay by the sideline.

family: Right Wing — Step Inside to Clear the Passing Lane
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender blocks the sideline pass with an extended arm but leaves a lane one metre inside.

family: Right Wing — Hips Turn Back to the Corner
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender has turned hips and first step back to you before RB can pass — do not demand the early wing ball.

family: Right Wing — Create Width for the Right Back’s Drive
primaryTacticalCue: RW is too close to RB and wing defender can help inside — move wide before the RB initiates the drive.

family: Right Wing — Choose the Short Release
primaryTacticalCue: RB is trapped; short return to nearby pivot is clear while long diagonal is crossed by a defender.

family: Right Wing — Right Back Is Not Ready
primaryTacticalCue: RB receives facing away and still controlling the ball — do not start the wing run before the passer can see you.

family: Right Wing — Enter on the Second Bind
primaryTacticalCue: RB has drawn the wing defender inward a second time and the corner behind him is empty — entry is now timed.

family: Right Wing — Back-Door Lane Opens
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender jumps outward toward the RB and loses sight of RW — back-door lane is open.

family: Right Wing — Do Not Crowd the Right Back
primaryTacticalCue: RB has a clear drive between half and wing defender; an early RW entry would occupy the same lane.

family: Right Wing — Enter After Help Leaves You
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender has left the corner to cover the pivot after the RB passes — attack the space behind him immediately.

family: Right Wing — Find the Pivot’s Roll
primaryTacticalCue: Pivot seals the wing defender’s inside shoulder then rolls to six metres as your take-off closes.

family: Right Wing — Pivot Is a Decoy, Hold the Corner
primaryTacticalCue: Pivot moves across as a decoy and takes the half defender; RW must stay wide to exploit the wing defender’s help.

family: Right Wing — Pivot Pass Is Not Available
primaryTacticalCue: Central defender’s arm and body sit in the pivot-pass line; RB is free for a return.

family: Right Wing — Deep Goalkeeper, Finish Late
primaryTacticalCue: GK stays on goal line through take-off rather than attacking the wing — carry the ball deeper and read the posts late.

family: Right Wing — Goalkeeper Attacks the Take-Off
primaryTacticalCue: GK steps two metres out with body forward before release — space behind him opens, so lift is available only over his reach.

family: Right Wing — Hands Drop Before the Lob
primaryTacticalCue: GK has stepped out but both hands fall below shoulder level before release — lob becomes available.

family: Right Wing — Read the Opening in Flight
primaryTacticalCue: During take-off GK shifts to the near post and opens the far side — adjust release in flight.

family: Right Wing — Goalkeeper Near Arm Stays High Before Take-Off
primaryTacticalCue: GK near arm stays high and committed to near high corner before take-off — finish low under that arm

family: Right Wing — First Wave 2v1: Stay the Wide Pass Option
primaryTacticalCue: Lone defender between CB and goal — hold right width at six metres as the pass option, do not crowd

family: Right Wing — Secure a Pressured Transition Catch
primaryTacticalCue: High pass behind right shoulder + recovering defender on sideline — secure and short return

family: Right Wing — Cut Behind Only After the Fix
primaryTacticalCue: Recovering defender between you and CB — hold lane until CB fixes him, then cut behind

family: Right Wing — Safe Continuation When the Counter Finish Is Gone
primaryTacticalCue: Wing defender already between you and goal with hand up — short return, no forced finish

family: Right Wing — 6v5 with Covered Take-Off: Recycle
primaryTacticalCue: 6v5 but wing defender square on take-off with hand up — short return, do not force

family: Right Wing — 5v6: Hold Width, Do Not Force the Corner
primaryTacticalCue: Player down — wing defender stays between you and near post; hold width as safe release for RB

family: Right Wing — 7v6: Use the Extra Space When the Wing Defender Steps In
primaryTacticalCue: Second pivot binds half/centre; wing defender steps inside — take off immediately while lane is open

family: Right Wing — 7v6 Covered on the Wing: Do Not Force
primaryTacticalCue: Two pivots inside but wing defender stays on you closing middle take-off — short return

family: Right Wing — Empty Own Goal: Clean Catch, Finish Now
primaryTacticalCue: Own GK out, clean catch, wing defender still a full stride late — finish immediately

family: Right Wing — Opponent Empty Goal: Finish Immediately
primaryTacticalCue: Opponent GK late returning from bench — empty net — finish immediately, no invented post choice

family: Right Wing — After the Right Back Draws Two: Finish
primaryTacticalCue: RB pulls half + wing defender; you stay wide and receive free with open take-off — finish

family: Right Wing — Jumped After the Right Back Drew Two: Short Return
primaryTacticalCue: RB drew two but wing defender recovers onto your catch with hand up — short return

family: Right Wing — Rotation Leaves the Corner Open: Finish
primaryTacticalCue: During cross/rotation wing defender steps inside to take new man — take-off still open — finish now

family: Right Wing — Rotation Already Closed the Corner: Recycle
primaryTacticalCue: Pass arrives late after cross; wing defender already finished handover and stands on take-off — short return

family: Right Wing — Protect a One-Goal Lead
primaryTacticalCue: Leading by one: wing defender closes the take-off and the safe return is free — keep possession, do not force the corner shot

family: Right Wing — One Down: Use the Brief Window
primaryTacticalCue: Trailing by one: wing defender is still inside after helping on RB and the take-off lane is open now

family: Right Wing — Passive Warning: Finish the Clear Lane
primaryTacticalCue: Passive warning with wing defender inside and clear take-off lane — finish, do not pass away the last clean chance

family: Right Wing — Passive Warning: Do Not Force a Closed Wing
primaryTacticalCue: Passive warning but wing defender is square and GK out — use the free return, do not force a closed wing shot

family: Right Wing — Late Possession: Secure a Bad Catch
primaryTacticalCue: Late tie: ball arrives behind the body and defender closes take-off — secure the catch with a return

family: Right Wing — Use the Clock With a Safe Return
primaryTacticalCue: Leading late with a closed wing and free short return — use possession and clock

family: Right Wing — Deny the Opponent’s Fast Restart After Turnover
primaryTacticalCue: Turnover on right side — sprint into lane to deny long first pass to their wing before celebrating

family: Right Wing — Defence: Help After the Handover
primaryTacticalCue: Team 6:0 rule: wing protects the wing pass until half calls and takes handover; after handover, help inside

family: Right Wing — Defence: Close the Transition Lane
primaryTacticalCue: First-wave 3v2: ball carrier central, far wing wide — take the direct pass lane to your wing before chasing ball

family: Right Wing — Defence: Return Through the Correct Lane
primaryTacticalCue: On return, ball is central and your wing runs wide — recover between ball and wing, not through the crowded middle

family: Right Wing — Defence: Stop the First Wave
primaryTacticalCue: First wave has a central ball carrier and free wing; delay ball legally while teammate recovers to wing lane

family: Right Wing — Defence: Solve the 2v2 on Your Side
primaryTacticalCue: Team rule: half takes back, wing stays with wing until called; back and wing create 2v2

family: Right Wing — Defence: Deny the Long First Pass
primaryTacticalCue: After your shot, their goalkeeper has ball and far wing releases early — take first-pass lane before dropping deep

family: Right Wing — Defence: Ball or Wing?
primaryTacticalCue: Ball carrier threatens outside but wide wing is free; no handover means protect wing pass with controlled ball pressure

family: Right Wing — 5:1: Read the Wide Defender and Point
primaryTacticalCue: 5:1 point chases RB while wide defender stays inside — hold width for the immediate pass

family: Right Wing — 3:3: Move the Ball Wide Fast
primaryTacticalCue: 3:3 outside defender steps high to RB; ball must reach wide wing before the next line slides

family: Right Wing — 4:2: Finish the Free Lane
primaryTacticalCue: 4:2 front defender follows RB inside; wing defender cannot recover across the free take-off lane

family: Right Wing — Defence: 1v1 on Your Wing Without Fouling Early
primaryTacticalCue: Open defence 1v1: stay between ball and goal, force wide, do not dive early

family: Right Wing — 3:2:1: Go Behind the High Wing Defender
primaryTacticalCue: 3:2:1 wing defender steps high to RB and turns to ball — enter behind only after RB fixes him

family: Right Wing — Defence: When Their Wing Stays High, Do Not Chase Blindly
primaryTacticalCue: 1:5 — opposing wing high; protect deep lane and ball side, do not chase into no-man land
